newsitem.title: USA: Plasma-Therm sees contined growth in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Plasma-Therm sees contined growth in Q3.

text.p: Plasma-Therm Inc said it expects fiscal third quarter results to reflect the continued growth in revenue and earnings it experienced in the first half of 1997.

Plasma-Therm noted that net income rose to $0.18 a share compared with $0.14 a share for the six months ended May 31, an increase it attributed to increased shipments of its Versalock and Shuttlelock product lines.
The company also reported second quarter net income of $1.2 million, or $0.10 a share, compared with $893,000, or $0.08 a share during the year-ago period.
